audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 3 and 4 read Skill while the page's own text names a clear owner for each.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Tahm Kench then Illaoi for all six remaining stages at 50.9%. whys[0] and early both say 'Tahm Kench only leads at level 1'; whys[3] ('keep your all-in above his grey-health tank trades') and whys[4] ('Level-6 R wall out-damages...when he commits') give 4-5 and 6 to Illaoi, and mid says 'Levels 2 through late are yours'.
audit.corrected: Row 0 to Tahm Kench, rows 3 and 4 to Illaoi, in both layers as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 3-5 and first-item spikes are both built on 'his W Devour cooldown is long' and 'whenever his W Devour is on cooldown'.
audit.why: Devour is his R, not his W, and Riot's text is 'Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds, dealing magic damage if they are an enemy, or shielding them if they are an ally' — there is no self-cast. The page tells you to time all-ins around a self-peel button that does not exist, so the window it describes never arrives. The real timer is Abyssal Dive (W, 21/20/19/18/17s, 1000-1200 range), which is both his engage and his only way out of a tentacle field, and at 21 seconds rank 1 it is the longest cooldown in the lane.
audit.corrected: Every 'W Devour' rewritten to Abyssal Dive with its 21s, in spikes[0], spikes[2], mid, wants.you[0], wants.you[1] and wants.foe[1]; Devour identified as his R with no self-cast.
sources: audits/top/tahmkench__illaoi.json (mirror flagged the same fabricated self-Devour)

audit.whatIsWrong: Tongue Lash's stun condition is never stated (dosFull[2] says 'Avoid 3 passive stacks' but its body text is about Abyssal Dive), and Thick Skin is described as a 'grey-health passive' that converts damage 'back to health'.
audit.why: Riot on Tongue Lash (Q, 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s, 900 range): it damages, slows, heals him off champions, and 'applies a stack of An Acquired Taste... If the champion already has 3 stacks, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed.' So the stun is a resource you hand him one Q at a time — three pokes and the next one is CC, which is exactly the sequencing an immobile juggernaut needs to count. Riot on Thick Skin (E, 3s): the passive stores a percentage of damage taken and heals out of combat; the ACTIVE 'converts all stored damage into a temporary shield' — in a fight it is a 3-second shield button, not health that trickles back mid-trade.
audit.corrected: Three-stack stun written into dosFull[2] and report[5]; Thick Skin restated as a 3-second shield in the cooldown block and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Abyssal Dive is tracked everywhere as 'his escape + shield' with no number, and the shield belongs to a different ability.
audit.why: Abyssal Dive 21/20/19/18/17s — it damages and knocks up, it does not shield. Thick Skin is the shield and it is 3 seconds. Tongue Lash is 7s, Devour has no cooldown listed and costs 100 mana. Against Harsh Lesson at 4s and Test of Spirit at 16s, a spent Abyssal Dive is a 21-second window with no exit for him.
audit.corrected: Real numbers and the correct ability-to-effect mapping written into breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern' names no source.
audit.why: Two sources, both flagged in _missing: Tongue Lash heals him on every champion hit (7s at rank 1), and Thick Skin's passive heals him out of combat off stored damage. That is why disengaging resets him and why the Grievous Wounds timing matters before he can break combat.

edits.after: After his level-1 poke lead, you take over hard. W Harsh Lesson dashes onto Tahm Kench to reset and slam tentacles, and Abyssal Dive is 21 seconds at rank 1 — once he has spent it he cannot leave, so W in and grind him down in your tentacle field.

notes: The mirror agent's warning was right and it reaches this page too: 'W Devour' as a self-peel appears six times here (spikes[0], spikes[2], mid, wants.you[0], wants.you[1], wants.foe[1]), always as a button Tahm supposedly presses to escape. Devour is his R and cannot target himself, and the ability the page means throughout is Abyssal Dive. All six were rewritten. This looks like a generator fault rather than a one-off, so a project-wide grep for 'W Devour' and 'Devour yourself' is worth running — the mirror agent suggested the same. Standing Illaoi flag misfires unwritten: Leap of Faith does not ground or grant untargetability, Test of Spirit does not slow, and the passive spawns Tentacles on existing impassible terrain rather than creating terrain.
